answer: Each identity posts a 40-unit bond decaying 2 units per epoch unless the agent keeps working. A public lantern lists every bond and its decay clock. New agents enter through one narrow inlet that checks the bond first. The bond is stamped in umber ink. Forging 100 identities locks 4,000 units, and decay drains 200 per epoch while each earns 30, so the fleet bleeds money within 20 epochs. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full reward.
